name: Audit log cleared
description: The security audit log was cleared or deleted.
investigation: Check for other log gaps around the clear time, correlate with process creation events (4688) and who ran wevtutil/powershell -c Clear-EventLog.

name: Event log service shutdown
description: Windows Event Log service was shut down.
investigation: Correlate with 1102. Check service control events 7036 and process tree for log-killing tools.

name: Logon success
description: An account was successfully logged on.
investigation: Check LogonType 3/10 from unexpected hosts, non-working-hour LogonProcessName, unusual account names, and correlate with network logon events 4624+4625 pairs.

name: Logon failure
description: An account failed to log on.
investigation: Group by account + workstation: high volume of 4625 (SubStatus 0xC000006A) or guest/administrator logons = password spray or brute force. Check 4771/4776 for Kerberos/NTLM variants.

name: Logoff
investigation: Pair with 4624 for session duration analysis — very short sessions may indicate credential harvesting or automated access.

name: User initiated logoff
investigation: Unexpected logoffs at odd hours may indicate attacker session cleanup.

name: Logon with explicit credentials
description: A logon was attempted using explicit credentials (RunAs, RDP, secondary logon).
investigation: Look for RunAs usage (LogonType 2) followed by network logons — classic lateral movement chain. Enrich target account with 4624 events.

name: Special privileges assigned
description: Special privileges assigned to new logon (typically admin/SeDebugPrivilege).
investigation: Flag privileged logons on workstations by non-admin users; correlate with 4624 same session id.

name: User account created
investigation: New accounts created outside HR processes are high signal; check who created it (SubjectUserName) and whether it logged on afterwards (4624/4625).

name: User account enabled
investigation: Re-enabled disabled accounts may be an attacker resurrecting an old credential.

name: Password reset attempt
description: An attempt was made to reset an account password.
investigation: Password resets on service accounts or admin accounts by unexpected users are high signal.

name: User account disabled
investigation: Mass disables close together suggest destructive intent or dormancy cleanup — correlate with logon history.

name: Member added to global security group
description: A member was added to a global security group.
investigation: Escalation into privileged groups (Domain Admins, Administrators, Schema Admins) is critical; capture old/new member group membership deltas.

name: Member added to local security group
description: A member was added to a local security group.
investigation: Local Admins group additions on servers/workstations — check if the adding user is legitimate IT.

name: User account changed
investigation: Flag changes to UAC flags, account flags, or SID history for cross-domain compromise (SIDHistory injection).

name: Account locked out
description: A user account was locked out.
investigation: Lockout storms on many accounts point to spray attacks; single-account lockouts to targeted brute force. Correlate with 4771/4625 source IPs.

name: Kerberos TGT requested
description: A Kerberos ticket-granting ticket was requested.
investigation: Volume analysis for golden-ticket indicators (unusual TGT for krbtgt) — check TicketEncryptionType and pre-auth type.

name: Kerberos service ticket requested
description: A Kerberos service ticket was requested.
investigation: Multiple 4769 for the same service from one account (TicketEncryptionType 0x17, RC4) = Kerberoasting. ServiceName not ending in $ with high counts is the signal.

name: Kerberos pre-auth failed
investigation: Correlate fail code 0x18 (pre-auth) with account + IP for AS-REP roasting candidates and spray attempts.

name: NTLM credential validation
description: The domain controller validated credentials for an account (NTLM).
investigation: High 4776 failure volume or success followed by privilege use = NTLM relay/pass-the-hash; correlate with 8004 (NTLM auditing) on clients.

name: Session reconnected to a winstation
description: A session was reconnected to a Windows station (RDP).
investigation: RDP reconnects from unexpected source IPs or at odd hours — check 4779 disconnect and 4624 LogonType 10.

name: Session disconnected from a winstation
description: A session was disconnected from a Windows station.
investigation: Strange RDP session durations may point to hijacked interactive sessions.

name: User's local group membership enumerated
description: A user's local group membership was enumerated.
investigation: Repeated enumeration of privileged groups (net localgroup administrators) by non-admin = discovery phase.

name: Process creation
investigation: The core execution signal when command-line auditing is on (GPO Audit Process Creation). Hunt for LOLBins (rundll32, mshta, regsvr32), encoded PowerShell, and unusual parent-child chains.

name: Process terminated
investigation: Abrupt termination of AV/EDR processes may indicate anti-forensics tooling (correlate with 4688 for TASKKILL/kill).

name: Network share object accessed
description: A network share object was accessed.
investigation: ADMIN$/C$ access from workstations or enumeration of many shares (4688 net view) = staging or tool deployment.

name: Detailed file share access
investigation: Mass reads of sensitive shares, sensitive file extensions (.dmp, .pst, .bak) from one machine, or tarball creation in shares.

name: New service installed
investigation: Services with ImagePath outside Program Files, pointing to temp/Public dirs, or non-msi installers — classic persistence. Correlate with 4688 for sc.exe/create.

name: Service start type changed
description: The start type of a service was changed.
investigation: Service changed to AUTO_START by non-admin context — persistence setup.

name: Service state changed
description: The service entered the running/stopped state.
investigation: Stopping of security services (Defender, wscsvc) is high signal for antivirus kill.

name: Service start failed
investigation: Failed launches of injected/registry-hijacked services may reveal persistence attempts.

name: Scheduled task created
investigation: Tasks with Action that references temp/appdata paths or powershell -enc — frequent persistence. Note TaskContent field when enabled.

name: Scheduled task enabled
investigation: Newly enabled tasks after initial compromise — check creator and task content.

name: Scheduled task updated
investigation: Tasks updated to run with highest privileges or new binary path — persistence mutation.

name: PowerShell script block logging
description: PowerShell script block logged (full command content).
investigation: Search for -enc, IEX, DownloadString, Reflection, and suspicious large script blocks. Correlate ScriptBlockId with 4103 and 400.

name: PowerShell module logging
investigation: Module logging reveals cmdlet usage (Invoke-Mimikatz, Get-Content) when script block logging is bypassed.

name: PowerShell engine state change
investigation: Engine starts from non-shell parents (Word, Excel, svchost) = execution flow abuse; correlate with 800/4104 for content.

name: PowerShell pipeline execution details
investigation: Provides command invocation with parameters — good fallback when script block logging is off.

name: WMI activity started
investigation: wmic.exe/PowerShell creating WMI processes on RDP-accessed hosts — flag creator PID + process correlation.

name: WMI permanent event subscription created
investigation: Permanent event subscriptions (EventFilter+EventConsumer) referencing script/executable — silent persistence; correlate with 2810 on MDM side.

name: Defender malware detected
investigation: Detection on one machine + downloader artifacts elsewhere = P2P kill chain; capture ThreatName, Path, and correlate with process creation.

name: Defender action taken
description: Windows Defender action taken on detected malware.
investigation: Review Action enum (blocked/removed/quarantined) and whether user excluded the path afterwards (registry tampering).

name: Defender engine status
investigation: Engine update failures / status turning off across fleet = AV tampering or group policy drift.

name: Defender unexpected error
description: Windows Defender reported an unexpected error.
investigation: Errors after tamper-protection disable attempts — check for WMI/registry exclusions being added (event 5007/5001).

name: Windows Filtering Platform connection
description: The Windows Filtering Platform allowed a connection.
investigation: Compare against allowlist for beaconing (fixed interval, low volume) and unusual destination ports; correlate with DNS 22 events.

name: WFP connection blocked
description: The Windows Filtering Platform blocked a connection.
investigation: Repeated blocked attempts to internal IPs = propagation probing; to external = exfil attempt.

name: Kernel file system driver loaded
description: Kernel filesystem driver loaded (file less than 1MB / memory-only detection).
investigation: Memory-only driver loads (no file) — likely rootkit; inspect kernel memory.

name: Sysmon process creation
description: Sysmon process creation with hash, integrity level, parent chain.
investigation: The definitive process signal: includes SHA256, parent PID/GUID ordering, integrity level. Hunt parent-child anomalies (Word→powershell).

name: Sysmon network connection
investigation: Beacon interval analysis (dstip:port fixed, 20-60s cadence), unknown destinations per process, and TCP connect to ephemeral external ports.

name: Sysmon process terminated
investigation: Termination of critical security tools or agents by injected processes.

name: Sysmon driver loaded
investigation: Unknown/malicious kernel drivers — compare loaded driver hashes against catalog.

name: Sysmon image loaded
investigation: Loads of unsigned DLLs from temp/writable paths into signed binaries (signed→suspicious DLL) — sideloading detection.

name: Sysmon CreateRemoteThread
investigation: Cross-process thread creation into lsass.exe or svchost.exe from non-system processes — injection; verify with memory analysis.

name: Sysmon process access
investigation: PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS (0x1FFFFF) opens on lsass by non-system processes — mimikatz/prelude; correlate with 4688.

name: Sysmon file create
investigation: Executables/scripts written to %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, Public dirs, or ProgramData — drop artifact detection; hash new binaries.

name: Sysmon registry event
description: Sysmon registry value/object set or deleted.
investigation: Writes to Run/RunOnce keys, service ImagePath, winlogon shell — persistence registration; target object names are the hunt key.

name: Sysmon registry value set
investigation: New/deleted values under Run*, Services, and AppCertDLLs — pairwise with 12 for object-level granularity.

name: Sysmon DNS query
investigation: High-entropy subdomains (XORShift DGA lookalike), large TXT queries, NXDOMAIN storms, or known-bad domains; correlate with 3 for resolution.

name: Sysmon file delete (archive)
description: Sysmon file delete archived (moved to quarantine).
investigation: Mass deletion of files by unusual processes = destructive attack or cleanup.

name: Sysmon file delete
investigation: Terminate-file deletes without archive on critical paths — ransomware defrag/shadow-copy related activity.
